statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated in writing as information security lead and records custodian
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with outside review every second year
Annual policy review
Sanctions for any future employee; department report of hires and terminations
Written, time-limited exceptions
Client access information is Restricted and used only for that client
Codes only in the password manager vault and patrol app post orders; never in files, notes, email, or texts
One sealed paper copy of codes and recovery codes in the home safe
Coded key tags; lockbox or safe; key log; monthly key count
2-hour client notice of a lost key or exposed code; contract-end return and deletion
regulatory_driver: Client agreements (2-hour notice; return of information)

statement_summary: Vendor list; annual SOC 2 review; read terms before Restricted data goes to a new service
Own accounts; separate business and family laptop accounts
App-based MFA on the patrol app admin, email, and accounting; MFA for client users
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager; defaults changed
Client portal accounts on written request; same-day removal; quarterly review
Phone 6-digit passcode, 30-second lock, previews hidden; laptop 5-minute lock
Recovery codes in the sealed copy in the safe
Monthly review of patrol app and email sign-in logs
Three-level classification
Restricted data only in approved locations
Encryption on every device; camera clips copied after each shift and the card cleared weekly
No codes or personal information by text or email body
Reports state observations only; changes only as dated addenda
Announce recording; counsel's audio rule; expiring, logged clip sharing
Shredding; device and card wipe or certified destruction with a record
Retention schedule: 2-year minimum for records, 90 days for video, 5 years for determinations and security records
Business use of devices; owner-only software installs on the business account
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
GPS tracking only of the owner's phone during shifts
AI tools only after assessment; owner sets priority; urgent events by phone; drafts read in full
Never request, accept, or store criminal justice information
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R01 (CJIS Security Policy; avoided); C-EMERGENCY-R02 (28 CFR 20.21(f))

statement_summary: Annual security course and monthly reminders
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
2-hour and 24-hour client notice
Breach decision with counsel; notices within P08 matrix deadlines
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Department notice of a claim against the liability insurance
Written agreement with a licensed backup agency; emergency sheet
Spare phone and paper patrol log forms
